descriptionBody: An official collector's polo from the Ganesh Galli Mandal. Crafted in heritage graphite grey with a regal golden Ganpati crest on the chest and the iconic red Mumbaicha Raja seal on the back. Every stitch carries 96 years of devotion. A portion of every purchase supports the Mandal's social initiatives.
